allocation_policy: Kaggle first; use free account quota without a user-defined spend cap
Lightning and Modal each have a normal base cap of $2.50
A shared additional reserve of $2.00 may be spent automatically when it unlocks a blocked/high-information experiment
Combined paid spend may not exceed $7.00 without new explicit approval
No single paid provider may exceed $4.50 without new explicit approval

kaggle.note: Use available free quota as needed; stop only on account quota/runtime limits or experiment stop conditions.

performance_policy.no_rank_freeze_before: comparable real candidates are run on adequate hardware
